propositions: Root disk fills to 92-96% and remains pinned during quiescent main because autodeploy.sh exits early on no-op ticks without reclaiming docker garbage.
prune_docker_caches() function is defined after its intended call site on the no-op early-exit path, making it uncallable from there; relocation to the helper block must precede first use.
A pressure-triggered reclaim with absolute threshold (80%, below 85% alarm) and 10-minute throttle window should fire on quiescent ticks to prevent disk saturation without per-tick churn.
Prune failures on the pressure path must not alter the script's exit code or control flow; they are logged only.
The new AUTODEPLOY_DISK_PRESSURE marker must be emitted to stderr exactly once per triggered prune and zero times when below threshold or throttled.
